method.authority: PDF object/content-stream affine geometry; image-feature registration is not used for primary bounds
method.pixel_coordinates: embedded JPEG pixels, top-left origin; image-space y is inverted into PDF's bottom-left normalized coordinates
method.crop_recovery: Invert each crop PDF's direct image-placement CTM at all visible CropBox corners; identical XObject bytes identify the same JPEG sample coordinate system
method.rotation_handling: Apply source page /Rotate after carrying recovered image points through the original source PDF image CTM; reorder corners into display TL/TR/BR/BL after the 90-degree turn
method.rounding: No rounding in recovered evidence; production candidate values are shown at full precision

inverse_crop_ctm.matrix_convention: PDF six-value [a,b,c,d,e,f], affine applied to normalized image coordinates
